metadata.title: Opindx replication: Open Journal Factor, Network Factor and Article Network Score
metadata.description: Reproducible journal metrics from downloaded OpenAlex Works/Sources Parquet snapshots and the Norwegian Register. Version 0.5.0 adds the five-year Open Journal Factor (OJF5) alongside OJF2, complete annual CSV/XLSX/Parquet export, and the matching website with independent percentile pools. Includes NF/ANS citation-network calculations, reviewed identity corrections, field metadata and the corresponding website and percentile engine. All thirty prior NF/ANS and OJF2 annual files and frozen-year NF/ANS pins remain unchanged. Validation includes the preserved NF/ANS baseline, exact OJF2 frozen-type-count replay, source-bound OJF5 calculation checks, independent fixtures, browser-window separation and all-cell export verification. The OJF5 target metadata was extended to 2017-2019 while retaining verified citing reference arrays. No repeated complete raw-snapshot replay of prior NF/ANS or OJF2 data is claimed. No proprietary metrics, commercial roster, benchmark matches or empirical paper-comparison outputs are bundled.
